**Summary of findings:** CapRover (⭐ 15k, v1.14.2 May 2026) is the lightest self-hosted PaaS option (~300–400 MB idle RAM) with solid Docker Swarm clustering and a proven 9-year track record. For the homelab PR preview use case it scores poorly: each app tracks exactly one branch with no native per-PR environment concept, and Docker Compose support covers only 6 fields with everything else silently dropped. Implementing PR previews requires scripted GitHub Actions + CapRover REST API calls per PR. Coolify (⭐ 57k) and Dokploy (⭐ 35k) are better fits for that workflow.
